name: Manamusume no Oshiri wa Papa Sen'you ~Tsuma no Mae de, Konna Koto o Suru Nante…~
original_name: 愛娘のお尻はパパ専用 ～妻の前で、こんな事をするなんて…～
source:
My daughter Yuri is full of energy, and my wife Rumiko is homely and kind. Blessed with such a wife and children, I was spending very happy days.

But my daily life changed drastically.  It was a holiday... I happened to overhear Yuri and Rumiko having a ridiculous conversation.

She said, “You want to do something about the fact that our sex life is in a rut, don't you, Mom?”

She said, “Yeah...I guess so...” 

"Then why don't you try anal sex?” 

"I'm not too keen on that..."

"Then how about this? I'll have anal sex with dad in front of you, mom."

The conversation went on and on and on. In the end I wound up having sex with Yuri...

I wonder what is going to happen to me...?

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_067.html#story]official site[/url]]
translation:
我的女儿由梨精力充沛，妻子留美子朴素而温柔。有这样幸福的妻女，我一直过着非常快乐的日子。

但我的日常发生了剧变。那是一个假日……我偶然听到由梨和留美子进行了一段荒唐的对话。

她说：“妈妈，你也想改变我们性生活陷入倦怠的现状吧？”

她说：“嗯……大概吧……”

“那为什么不试试肛交？”

“我不是很想……”

“那这样吧？妈妈，我就在你面前和爸爸肛交。”

对话没完没了。最后，我竟然和由梨发生了关系……

我不知道自己将会变成什么样……？
